gateText: Encumbered at 54 kg or more: no sprinting or jumping, slower leg stamina regeneration, slower aiming down sights, until you drop below 54 kg.
softText: Measured by one community Steam guide ("The Weight & Mobility Bible", written for 0.4), not a game value. Below 54 kg, weight is a smooth drain on leg stamina; these are where that guide felt it change.
